neighbours.label: an agent or instrument noun suffix in CJK text (者, 器, 家, 가: the 'person/device that does X' ending)
fire: 这项研究由三位年轻的学者完成，他们来自北京。

이 문서는 전문 번역가가 직접 확인했습니다.

这位作曲家的新作品在上海首演，获得好评。

notes: Top peaks are suffixes forming 'one who / device that' nouns: 者, 器, 가 (번역가, 찬송가), バー, Russian -ёр. Near misses: same-language sentences on the same topic without such a suffix noun.
